# Subway Seat for Codex CLI

TextMate themes tuned for Codex, whose diff backgrounds come from the theme's added and removed scopes. The status line picks up the same warm syntax colors.

[Codex CLI](https://github.com/openai/codex) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/codex/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.tmTheme`](subway-seat.tmTheme) | `~/.codex/themes/subway-seat.tmTheme` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.tmTheme`](subway-seat-tunnel.tmTheme) | `~/.codex/themes/subway-seat-tunnel.tmTheme` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.tmTheme`](subway-seat-enamel.tmTheme) | `~/.codex/themes/subway-seat-enamel.tmTheme` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.codex/config.toml, after copying the theme to ~/.codex/themes/ (or pick it with /theme):

```toml
[tui]
theme = "subway-seat"
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.codex/config.toml, after copying the theme to ~/.codex/themes/ (or pick it with /theme):

```toml
[tui]
theme = "subway-seat-tunnel"
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.codex/config.toml, after copying the theme to ~/.codex/themes/ (or pick it with /theme):

```toml
[tui]
theme = "subway-seat-enamel"
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.codex/themes/subway-seat.tmTheme`.
- Delete `~/.codex/themes/subway-seat-tunnel.tmTheme`.
- Delete `~/.codex/themes/subway-seat-enamel.tmTheme`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
